description.value: Stacked Pancake & Breakfast House is a proudly Canadian breakfast-and-lunch chain founded in 2016, now operating 130+ locations coast to coast. The Langley location serves creative pancake stacks alongside classic egg dishes, hashes, French toast, waffles, crepes, and a lunch menu — all available for dine-in or takeout. It is a family-oriented sit-down restaurant with a menu broad enough to satisfy most dietary preferences.

address.value: 8045 204 Street, Unit D100, Langley, BC V2Y2A9
